notes: Reached DIRECTLY (plain urllib, HTTP 200) - no proxy or impersonation needed. Platform: Shopify (Dawn-derived theme). Category tree is FLAT: the mega-menu 'Decor' node has no children of its own depth - its members are Art, Wall Decor, Rugs, Lighting, Pillows, Mirrors, Books, Tabletop, Bedding, Home Fragrance, Plants & Planters, and the sitemap_collections_1.xml (329 URLs, of which 207 are 'room-ideas-*' inspiration sets) confirms no deeper sub-collections exist. Hence NO parent grouping rows - every in-scope category is a leaf. COUNTS: taken from the rendered listing header N products on each collection page. VERIFIED per Rule 1 by independent exhaustion: enumerated every collection via /collections//products.json?limit=250&page=N to exhaustion and counted unique product IDs - all 7 collections matched their rendered header EXACTLY (lighting 1005=1005, art 1970=1970, wall-decor 202=202, mirrors 438=438, tabletop 758=758, plants-planters 92=92, books 70=70). SUBSET CHECK: compared product-ID sets pairwise across all seven; the five emitted rows are effectively disjoint (largest overlap art&wall-decor = 11 items, 5% of the smaller), so no double-counting. DELIBERATELY NOT SPLIT: each collection carries a 'Product Type' facet (filter.p.m.custom.product_type_category) with its own exact rendered counts (e.g. Chandelier '229 of 1005 products'), but this metafield is an unreliable taxonomy, not a real hierarchy - Lighting has a 193-item residual bucket literally named 'Lighting' that on inspection contains pendants, flush mounts, table lamps and sconces, so 'Pendants (46)' materially undercounts pendants; on Art the facet values sum to 2345 against a 1970 total (overlapping multi-value metafield). Emitting those as sub-categories would have been misleading, so the five site collections are reported whole. EXCLUDED: Rugs, Pillows, Bedding (textiles); all Furniture / Storage / Outdoor / Mattresses branches; Home Fragrance (out of scope by rule); Plants & Planters (92) - read every title, it is essentially wholly artificial botanicals ('Blue Eucalyptus in Lait Planter', 'Snake Plant in Small Bubble Bowl', peony/hydrangea bouquets), i.e. faux plants, which the brief excludes, with only ~4 bare baskets otherwise; Books (70) - a mixed set of genuine fashion/design publications (Tom Ford, Dior Glamour, Gucci: The Making Of) alongside 'Stack of Books' decor props, and books are not in the include list. Tabletop (758) was checked title-by-title before inclusion: it is decorative objects, not dinnerware - 123 bowls, 113 vases, 113 sculptures, 70 trays, 32 boxes, 28 bookends, ~30 candleholders/candlesticks, plus brass figurines and centerpieces - so it is filed under Home Accessories rather than Kitchen & Dining; it contains only 4 scented items (Apothecary Guild candle jars) out of 758, which is noise rather than a fragrance roll-up. Rows are in site navigation order.
